content: परिधा €3 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To put or wear (as a garment); त्वचं स मेध्यां परिधाय रौरवीम् <ls>R. 3. 31</ls>. .²2 To surround, enclose. .²3 To direct towards. .²4 To put or place round. .²5 To cast round the eyes, turn the glance upon. .²6 To conclude, close (as the recitation of a hymn). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to put on, clothe with.
